business_summary: Western Asset High Yield Opportunity Fund Inc. is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched and managed by Legg Mason Partners Fund Advisor, LLC. The fund is co-managed by Western Asset Management Company, Western Asset Management Company Pte. Ltd., Western Asset Management Company Ltd and Western Asset Management Company Limited. It invests fixed income markets across the globe. The fund invests in high-yield corporate fixed income securities with varying maturities. It invests in below investment grade fixed income securities. Western Asset High Yield Opportunity Fund Inc. was formed on July 20, 2010 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Western Asset High Yield Opportunity Fund Inc.는 Legg Mason Partners Fund Advisor, LLC가 시작하고 관리하는 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Western Asset Management Company, Western Asset Management Company Pte.가 공동 관리합니다. Ltd., Western Asset Management Company Ltd 및 Western Asset Management Company Limited가 있습니다. 전 세계 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 다양한 만기의 고수익 기업 채권에 투자합니다. 투자등급 이하의 채권에 투자합니다. Western Asset High Yield Opportunity Fund Inc.는 2010년 7월 20일에 설립되었으며 미국에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
